description: Base Renovate preset for @unabandoned forks: keep dependencies current, soak new releases before adopting them, automerge once green, pin the supply chain, flag anything that itself becomes abandoned, and fast-track security fixes.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge Renovate PRs that bump our own first-party config repos - the unabandoned/.github reusable-workflow digest ('commit tag') pins and the unabandoned/renovate-config preset. These are internal and reviewed at source, so adopt them immediately on green with no soak. They land as `chore(deps)` (CI-only, not `fix`), so release-please never cuts a release for them. Use branch-strategy automerge so Renovate lands the pin directly on green instead of leaving a PR that sits unmerged whenever GitHub-native PR auto-merge isn't armed on the fork - if the branch can't be pushed (e.g. a protected base), Renovate falls back to a normal automerged PR.
